version: 3.7 (feature/jungle-base-3.7) — Deep Jungle (Firebase Viper) on Balanced, with Desert Outpost and Tokyo regression in the same session
machine: Apple M5, Chrome, ANGLE Metal, 120 Hz display, DPR 2, same window and session
method: __dev.bench(3) with the Balanced preset applied in memory (pixel ratio 1.25, 60 FPS cap, 3 bloom levels; the saved settings were not changed). The jungle was rebuilt after the switch (via the desert) so foliage is at Balanced density.
notes: The compound added ~50k triangles over 3.6 (324k → 374k at Balanced density) and no measurable GPU time: 3.6's jungle measured 5.7–6.4 ms.
Draw calls 65–129 (3.6: 53–92, 176 in the High-density fight). Static geometry merges per material; the concertina is one InstancedMesh.

P95 is ~17.7 ms in every setting this session (3.6 and 3.4 measured ~23 ms); the cap and display were the same, so it's session pacing, not a level change. Desert GPU is higher than in 3.6's session (4.4–5.3 → 5.6–6.0 ms) with no desert code changed: compare settings within one session, not across sessions.
